title: Partial identification via conditional linear programs: estimation and policy learning
abstract: arXiv:2506.12215v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many quantities of interest are only partially identified from observable data: the data can limit them to a set of plausible values, but not uniquely determine them. This paper develops a framework for covariate-assisted estimation, inference, and decision making in partial identification problems where the parameter of interest satisfies linear constraints conditional on covariates. Bounds on the parameter can be written as expectations of solutions to conditional linear programs with covariate-dependent objectives and constraints that must be estimated from data. Examples include estimands involving joint distributions of potential outcomes, policy learning with inequality-aware value functions, and instrumental variable settings. translated_title: 基于条件线性规划的部分识别：估计与政策学习
translated_abstract: 许多感兴趣的量只能从可观测数据中得到部分识别：数据可以将其限制在一组合理取值范围内，但无法唯一确定它们。本文开发了一个用于部分识别问题中协变量辅助估计、推断与决策制定的框架，其中感兴趣的参数在给定协变量的条件下满足线性约束。参数的界可以写成条件线性规划解的期望形式，这些线性规划具有依赖于协变量的目标函数和约束条件，且需从数据中估计得到。应用实例包括涉及潜在结果联合分布的估计量、基于不平等感知价值函数的政策学习，以及工具变量设定。我们提出了两个去偏估计量。第一个估计量使用插件估计求解条件线性规划，并利用线性规划求解器的标准输出进行去偏，从而避免了计算上的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于条件线性规划的部分识别统一框架，通过两个去偏估计量实现协变量辅助的估计与推断，可应用于潜在结果联合分布、政策学习和工具变量等多种问题。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a unified framework for partial identification via conditional linear programs, proposing two de-biased estimators for covariate-assisted estimation and inference, with applications to joint distributions of potential outcomes, policy learning, and instrumental variable settings.
